title: The Complete Prague Travel Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the ultimate trip to Prague with our 2026 guide. Discover the best attractions, food, neighborhoods, and hidden gems.
excerpt: Prague is a destination that rewards the curious traveler. Beyond the well-known attractions lies a world of hidden gems and unforgettable experiences.
author: Wanderlust Team
content:
There is something about Prague that captures the imagination of travelers worldwide. For those planning a trip to Prague, this guide will show you the best of what awaits.

## Best Time to Visit

The ideal time to explore Prague depends on what you want to experience. Spring brings mild weather and blooming landscapes.

## Top Attractions

- Must-see sights that define Prague
- Hidden treasures only locals know about
- Historical sites that tell the story of Czech Republic
- Scenic viewpoints for unforgettable photos

![Prague landscape](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1571778200037-250828fe3eee?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Local Cuisine

No trip to Prague is complete without sampling the local food. From street-side vendors to fine dining establishments, the culinary scene reflects the region's rich heritage and innovative spirit.

## Getting Around

Walking is the best way to experience the true charm of Prague, with most major sights within easy reach.

## Where to Stay

Luxury resorts and budget hostels coexist in Prague, giving travelers plenty of options.
